videos.title: Cyclone season is open
videos.hook: Cyclone season opened on 1 November. Your drying kit has until the first call to be ready.
videos.message: The 2026/27 season runs 1 November to 30 April. Check air movers, dehumidifiers and scrubbers now, while there is time to fix or replace them.
videos.approvedRender: v3, commit 0e687840f, approved by Phill 08/11/2026 for 09/11/2026 07:00 AEST. Do not re-render.

videos.title: A quiet forecast is not a dry season
videos.hook: Forecasters expect five to eight named cyclones this season. The phones still ring after every storm.
videos.message: ECMWF modelling points to 5 to 8 named storms against a long-term average of 11. Storms, flash flooding and burst pipes still bring water jobs. Be ready for the work, not the forecast.
products: Water Claw Large Flood Extraction Tool

videos.title: Four placed beat two powerful
videos.hook: Four air movers in the right places will beat two powerful ones aimed at the middle of the room.
videos.message: Evaporation is a surface-area problem. That is why the number of units usually matters more than any one unit's specification. Placement matters as much as power.

videos.title: Low profile goes where standard cannot
videos.hook: Most of the wet area in a furnished home is under something.
videos.message: Under a bed, against a skirting, beneath a vanity. A low-profile air mover reaches the places a standard unit cannot.
products: XPOWER PL700A Low Profile Air Mover

videos.title: Check the plug and the frequency
videos.hook: Two machines can look the same and still not be the same machine.
videos.message: Check the plug and the frequency. Anything specified at 50 Hz 220 V with an AU plug is built for this market. Imported units at 60 Hz are not the same machine.
products: Dry Air Max Force Ventilator 50 Hz AU plug

videos.title: The first 24 to 48 hours
videos.hook: Clean up water damage promptly, within 24 to 48 hours.
videos.message: SafeWork NSW says clean up wet areas and water damage promptly, within 24 to 48 hours. The Water Claw and SOS Pro pull water out of carpet and pad; the X-800 is designed to dry your floors.
products: Water Claw Medium Deluxe with Injection
SOS Pro Sub Surface Extraction Tool

videos.title: Not all water is the same
videos.hook: Clean water, grey water and sewage are three different jobs.
videos.message: The water damage standard sorts water into Category 1, 2 and 3. Time and temperature can move it to a worse category. The category decides the method and the protection.

videos.title: The pre-filter protects the HEPA
videos.hook: The cheapest filter in an air scrubber protects the most expensive one.
videos.message: Air scrubber filters are staged. The pre-filter protects the HEPA. Running without it, or past its life, turns a cheap filter change into an expensive one.

videos.title: Count units per vehicle
videos.hook: The air mover that fits in the van is the one that dries the house.
videos.message: Stackability and footprint decide how many jobs a crew covers in a day. Count units per vehicle, not horsepower.
products: XPOWER X-600AC Air Mover with clamp

videos.title: Book a storm-ready check
videos.hook: Find the fault now, not on the first wet morning.
videos.message: Call CCW and describe how your kit is running. CCW's technicians diagnose most problems over the phone, and stocked parts go out the same day.

videos.title: Encapsulation or extraction
videos.hook: Selling encapsulation as a restorative clean is where commercial contracts go wrong.
videos.message: Encapsulation suits interim commercial maintenance where downtime is short. Extraction with a prespray and rinse is the restorative clean. Pick by the maintenance cycle.

videos.title: Razorback is made here
videos.hook: Spares for this machine are not waiting in an overseas parts queue.
videos.message: Razorback is CCW's own range. The portables are made in house, and the machines, chemistry and spares are backed by CCW in Australia.

videos.title: Match prespray to soil, then fibre
videos.hook: The prespray choice starts with the soil, not the bottle you used last time.
videos.message: Match prespray to the soil type first, then to the fibre. Enzyme prespray suits protein and organic soil. Every prespray needs the right rinse behind it.

videos.title: UV light and pet urine
videos.hook: A blacklight shows more than urine, and that can mislead a quote.
videos.message: Other things fluoresce under UV too, and 365 nm and 395 nm lights behave differently. Toby's guide on the CCW blog explains how to inspect a room before you quote.

videos.title: Viscose rugs need low moisture
videos.hook: Viscose is one of the easiest rugs to damage for good.
videos.message: Browning, water marks, pile distortion and dye migration all come from the wrong method. Low-moisture cleaning and the right chemistry protect the rug. The full method is in Toby's guide.
products: Sapphire Scientific Clear-View Upholstery Pro AW59

videos.title: The clear-view upholstery tool
videos.hook: Seeing the water you pull out is how you stop over-wetting a lounge.
videos.message: The Sapphire Clear-View Upholstery Pro has a clear head, so you can watch the extraction as you work. Its flow control lets you set the solution for the fabric.
products: Sapphire Scientific Clear-View Upholstery Pro AW59

videos.title: The glide is a part, not the wand
videos.hook: When the wand starts to drag, the glide is usually the part to look at.
videos.message: Sapphire titanium wands take replaceable glides in 12 and 14 inch. Check the glide and swap it when it is worn, rather than living with a wand that drags.

videos.title: What 1:32 actually means
videos.hook: One to thirty-two is about 31 mL of concentrate for every litre of water.
videos.message: Getting dilution wrong costs chemistry or results. CCW's free calculator turns any ratio into millilitres for a sprayer or a bucket.

videos.title: Rotary extraction, explained
videos.hook: A rotary extractor scrubs and extracts in one pass.
videos.message: Rotary extraction tools such as the HydraMaster RX20 and the cordless Hydro-Force CX-15 agitate while they extract. Ask CCW which suits your jobs and your machine.
products: Hydro-Force CX-15 Cordless Rotary Extraction Tool

videos.title: Finance through one call
videos.hook: One finance broker. More than 20 lenders.
videos.message: CCW works with Equipped Commercial Finance, accredited with over 20 financiers, for rental, lease or chattel mortgage on equipment.

videos.title: A broken tool is a liability
videos.hook: A machine that will not start costs you the job, not just the repair.
videos.message: Malfunctioning equipment is a liability, not an asset. Downtime means lost jobs. Fix it before the busy weeks, not during them.

videos.title: Diagnosed over the phone
videos.hook: Describe the fault. Most can be found without the machine leaving your van.
videos.message: CCW's technicians diagnose most problems over the phone, for most brands, and send the stocked part the same day.

videos.title: Check your glides
videos.hook: A worn glide is a small part that shows up on every carpet you clean.
videos.message: Make a glide check part of your weekly van check. Replacement glides are stocked for Sapphire and Greenglides fittings.

videos.title: Hoses live longer on a reel
videos.hook: Kinked hose is lost pressure you pay for on every job.
videos.message: Inspect solution and vacuum hose before the busy season and store them on a reel. Space Saver reels hold 60 m and mount in the van.

videos.title: Dehumidifier pre-season check
videos.hook: A dehumidifier that sat dry all winter needs a look before it goes to a wet house.
videos.message: Before the season, check the filter, the hoses and the drain on every dehumidifier, following the maker's manual. A drip pan protects the floor while it runs.

videos.title: Air mover check in two minutes
videos.hook: Cord, guard, clamp, switch. Four checks before each air mover goes on the truck.
videos.message: Look over every cord, guard and clamp before the season. A damaged unit stays in the workshop.
products: XPOWER X-800 Air Mover with clamp

videos.title: A water softener in the van
videos.hook: Hard water leaves its mark inside your machine.
videos.message: A self-contained automatic water softener treats the water before it reaches the machine. Ask CCW whether your area and your machine need one.

videos.title: Automatic wastewater pump-out
videos.hook: A full recovery tank stops a job halfway through a room.
videos.message: An automatic wastewater disposal kit pumps the recovery tank out as you work, so you keep cleaning. Always dispose of wastewater the way your local council requires.

videos.title: Parts for more than one brand
videos.hook: CCW does not only stock parts for its own brands.
videos.message: CCW holds a wide range of spare parts across the brands carpet cleaners and restorers use, from filters to fittings.

videos.title: Last call before the wet
videos.hook: The best time to find a fault is before the first storm call.
videos.message: Ring CCW, run through your drying kit, and get any stocked part on its way the same day.

videos.title: Drying inside the cavity
videos.hook: Some of the water is behind the wall and under the floor.
videos.message: Injectidry systems move air into wall cavities and under floor coverings through hoses and panels. Ask CCW which pack suits floor, wall or ceiling work.
videos.cta: Ask CCW which pack suits you

videos.title: Axial for volume, ventilator for pressure
videos.hook: Open room or wall cavity: they need different fans.
videos.message: An axial fan moves a lot of air across an open space. Where air has to be pushed into a cavity or along a duct, a ventilator with layflat ducting is the right tool.
products: Dry Air Gale Force Axial Air Mover
videos.cta: See the air movers and ventilators

videos.title: Dry is a reading
videos.hook: Dry is a number on a meter, not a feeling on your hand.
videos.message: Take moisture readings at the start and on every visit, and record them. The readings show when the job is finished and back up your report.

videos.title: Extract before you dry
videos.hook: Every litre you extract is a litre your air movers do not have to evaporate.
videos.message: Pull standing water out of carpet and underlay with extraction tools first, then set up drying.
products: Water Claw Large Flood Extraction Tool
SOS Pro Floor Tool with Flush Kit

videos.title: Mould: removal comes first
videos.hook: Killing mould is not the same as removing it.
videos.message: The mould standard and CCW's Actichem guide say the same thing: source removal comes first. Products support the job; they do not replace removal.

videos.title: Contain before you remove
videos.hook: Mould work starts with plastic on the wall, not a scraper.
videos.message: Contain the work area before disturbing mould-affected material. Poly hangers and containment weights hold sheeting in place without damaging the room.

videos.title: A drying kit that works together
videos.hook: Air movers, a dehumidifier and a scrubber are one system, not three purchases.
videos.message: Air movers lift the water into the air, the dehumidifier takes it out, and a scrubber cleans the air where needed. Ask CCW to size a kit for the jobs you do.
videos.cta: Ask CCW to size your kit

videos.title: Have the kit before the work
videos.hook: The storm job will not wait for the equipment budget.
videos.message: Equipment finance through Equipped Commercial Finance covers rental, lease or chattel mortgage. The broker is accredited with more than 20 lenders.

videos.title: Three CCW sites, three states
videos.hook: Pick it up in Boondall, Seven Hills or Bayswater North.
videos.message: CCW runs its own sites in QLD, NSW and VIC, with partner agents in SA, WA and TAS. Call or visit before the holiday break.

videos.title: Five checks before the wet
videos.hook: Save this. Five checks to run before the next storm.
videos.message: Filters, glides, hoses, cords and a phone call to CCW for anything that does not sound right. Then follow CCW for the rest of the season.
